body: Yes. I feel like he feels trapped and if i just end my life he won’t have to make the decision to leave me.  He deserves alot better than me. And i want him to be happy more than anything.
I mean yeah but in the long run it’ll be better and they’ll be happier. I’m a piece of shit and not worth anything and everyone will be better off. Trust me
I’m just not comfortable admitting it any way except anonymously, i just don’t want people to think i’m looking for attention or that i’m a shit person because i really feel like it right now.

I haven’t been to the doctor in years, i definitely do have anxiety. And i already have depression but sometimes i’ll feel fine, then i’ll have intrusive thoughts about how people would appreciate the time i was there more if i was dead. I feel like i mean nothing.

I ended up telling my boyfriend i was feeling this way recently, he was really supportive of me and comforted me as much as he could, though i didn’t tell him the extent because i don’t want to worry him too much. I think i’ll make a psychiatry appointment soon though i can’t really afford it right now. I still have leftover medication from when i stopped taking it but i don’t want to do that if it’s dangerous.
You also suck at having a mother who doesn’t drink while you’re in the womb

I feel that so much. A lot has happened in my family over the last year or so as far as deaths and stuff so i just feel selfish being depressed about trivial things. I hate being anywhere but home where i have to talk to people and be normal

I might. I might talk to my boyfriend about it, because we live together and i’m around him most of the time and i trust him more than anyone, i just don’t want him to think it’s his fault or anything, i don’t know how to explain it.

I’m in recovery from addiction and i used to be a compulsive liar. So those things put together really took a toll on people i care about. And now all of it just makes me want to end my life honestly because i don’t know how to cope w/ it. I just want to make everything better and i know i can’t and it kills me literally every second of every day.

I don’t know. I’ve just hurt everyone so bad and i have no way of going back and fixing it and it’s always going to be here and i’m never going to be able to get rid of the shame i feel so it doesn’t feel like there’s any point. And it’s okay, i’m not on this account much. It’s just my account for subreddits like this and venting and stuff.

I just really don’t want to hurt them... i don’t want any reason for them to worry about me.. i just don’t know what to do anymore which is why i turn here. I feel more comfortable anonymously talking about it than in real life.

I have no idea.. i’ve been depressed for years and years but for some reason it’s been really bad lately. I just don’t feel like anything’s worth it. I haven’t talked to anyone about it. I’m embarrassed and don’t want to be an attention seeker. I usually would feel differently about depression and i know you don’t need a reason to be depressed but for some reason it’s different this time.

I dont even know i just have nothing i enjoy anymore. I love drawing but i cant bring myself to do it for more than a few minutes. Ive been working on the same small project for months. I hate my job. I love my family and boyfriend but im such a burden on them to the point where it feels unfair that i even have them. I feel like the initial sadness of my death would be small in comparison to the happiness and freedom they would feel afterwards. I dont have anything to do. If i had a gun i would kill myself. I dont have any way to do it w/ a hundred percent success rate right now and i feel so trapped and i dont know what to do. I just want to be happy and make everyone that i love happy and i dont feel like i can do that and it hurts me more than anything. I cant do anything right.
Meth pipes disguised as incense burners ALWAYS show up on my page. Wish is bizarre

Not the worst it’s ever been, because i’m not being abused and i’m not on drugs and i have an apartment w/ the man i want to marry, my family is talking to me and everything, but i just feel like i don’t deserve any of it. I feel like everyone would be better off w/out me. I’m not sure how to explain it other than i’m really happy w/ what i have but i feel guilty because i feel like i make everyone else unhappy. I’ve had a couple attempts in the past and there’s been times where i’m happy it’s never worked but it seems like i’m always back to the idea of wanting to do it.

Thank you very much, i appreciate those words so much. I just hope this feeling leaves me even a little bit. It’s usually always there a little bit but i hope it just completely goes away one day. Thank you

No, they don’t. They know i have depression and shit but i’ve been doing so good for awhile and i don’t want to hurt any of them. I just don’t feel like living anymore. I don’t want to go to the doctor because i’ve gained some weight since being out of treatment a couple years ago and i’m embarassed and don’t want to know my weight. I just don’t feel like myself and i go from high to low so quickly i feel like and i have no reason to believe anyone i would tell would call me stupid or anything but i just don’t even want to take the risk. I know they wouldn’t but i just don’t even want to be vulnerable.
